item.title: Inntro Shellcode & Pipeline toolschain
item.description:
Understanding payload execution at the binary level requires stripping away high-level abstractions and observing how the CPU processes raw machine code. Whether generating payloads via Metasploit (msfvenom) or compiling custom position-independent shellcode (PIC), the underlying compilation pipeline follows a deterministic path from assembly source code down to raw opcodes.

This write-up breaks down the internal mechanics of transforming x86_64 assembly into a clean, position-independent byte array, analyzing ELF object structures, relocation traps, and binary extraction workflows.

item.title: Process injection techniques & Windows Internals
item.description: Research into Windows internals and execution architecture, covering the PE format, Windows loader, process and memory management, execution environments, and core security components such as LSASS and AMSI. The research maps how these components interact from PE loading and process initialization through memory management, security boundaries, and runtime execution.

item.title: RDI sRDI loader using C and ASM
item.description:
Base Loader Manual PE Mapper

Manual PE Mapper / Reflective Loading Pipeline

The engine incorporates a custom Reflective DLL Injection (RDI) / manual mapping pipeline designed to instantiate PE payloads directly from memory without invoking the native operating system loader (LdrLoadDll / ntdll!LdrpLoadDll), completely bypassing standard user-mode loader callbacks and telemetry.

Manual Mapping Execution Sequence

  • Buffer Acquisition & Staging : Loading the raw PE binary from disk or memory storage into an unmapped temporary buffer (pRawBuffer).
  • PE Header Validation : Parsing and verifying foundational structures via IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE (MZ) and IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE (PE\0\0).
  • Virtual Memory Allocation : Reserving and committing virtual memory matching SizeOfImage via VirtualAlloc with initial PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE permissions.
  • Section Mapping : Copying PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) and iterating through the section header array to project raw data blocks into their respective relative virtual addresses (VirtualAddress ← PointerToRawData).
  • Base Relocations Resolution : Traversing the relocation directory (IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC) to apply delta adjustments (uDeltaBase = TargetBase - OptionalHeader.ImageBase) across absolute memory pointers.
  • Import Address Table (IAT) Patching : Resolving dependencies specified in IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT by loading required modules and patching function pointers into the IAT.
  • Entry Point Execution & Cleanup : Computing the absolute address of AddressOfEntryPoint, executing DllMain with the DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH reason code, and unmapping temporary staging buffers.

Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) & TTPs

MITRE ATT&CK ID Technique Name Implementation Detail
T1620 Reflective Code Loading Loading PE images directly into memory without utilizing the OS loader.
T1055.001 Process Injection: Dynamic-link Library Injection Manual mapping of DLL components with custom IAT resolution and relocation patching.
T1027.002 Obfuscated Files or Information: Software Packing Stripped PE headers and omitted disk artifacts through reflective execution.
